name: Unitree Dex5-S
summary: A human-sized 22-DoF hand from Unitree with backdrivable joints and impact-torque protection on all 22. It launched in September 2026 at US$6,500 (39,900 yuan in China). Unitree has not said how many of the 22 joints are independently actuated.

sources.title: Unitree Unveils Human-Sized Robot Hand Starting at $6,500 — Humanoids Daily
